name: Trexon - EZ Form Cable Corporation
old_description: We are thrilled to announce that EZ Form Cable is celebrating 40 amazing years in business!
about:
EZ Form Cable, an Amphenol company, has operated from Hamden, Connecticut since 1984. The business began as a specialist in coaxial transmission lines and has grown into a certified manufacturer of coaxial cables, cable assemblies, RF connectors, and coaxial delay lines.

The company produces a range of semi-rigid, flexible, and hand-formable coaxial cables, including 27 variants qualified to MIL-DTL-17. Its core competencies cover special impedance cables, low-attenuation assemblies, phase-matched sets, custom delay lines, and a line of stainless-steel and non-magnetic connectors. The EZF Builder online tool lets customers configure custom coaxial assemblies from standard diameters such as .047, .086, .141, and .250 inches. Production capabilities extend to build-to-print cable assemblies, coaxial baluns, and stripped-and-formed semi-rigid cables.

EZ Form serves military and aerospace programs, cryogenic and quantum computing research, telecommunications infrastructure, medical devices, instrumentation, and test laboratories. Its MIL-DTL-17 QPL products and phase-stable cables are used in applications where signal integrity at microwave and millimeter-wave frequencies is critical.

The company emphasizes a value proposition of quality product, right price, and on-time delivery, backed by a Quick Reaction Capability (QRC) program for rapid turnaround. It cites problem-solving connector designs, uniquely configured delay lines, and lead times described as the shortest in the industry as key differentiators.
